senses.gloss: m., constr. יְגַר ch. = h. אֵגוֹר, hill, heap of stones.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:47">Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 47</cite> (Y. <cite ref="A00547"><he>אוֹגַר</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="J00092"><he>יַגְרִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 26:18">Ib. XXVI, 18</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>יַגָרִין</he>); a. fr.—
Targ. Job XV, 28 יְגוֹרִין.—יְגַר שַׂהֲדוּתָא pr. n. pl. (bibl.) Y’gar Sahădutha (Hill of Testimony).
